ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A block of wood has the shape of a right circular cylinder with radius $6$ and height $8$, and its entire surface has been painted blue. Points $A$ and $B$ are chosen on the edge on one of the circular faces of the cylinder so that $\overarc{AB}$ on that face measures $120^\circ$. The block is then sliced in half along the plane that passes through point $A$, point $B$, and the center of the cylinder, revealing a flat, unpainted face on each half. The area of one of those unpainted faces is $a\cdot\pi + b\sqrt{c}$, where $a$, $b$, and $c$ are integers and $c$ is not divisible by the square of any prime. Find $a+b+c$.

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a cylinder cut open by an oblique plane; the cutting surface passes through points A and B on the edge of the same circular base, and passes through the center inside the cylinder; the exposed flat cutting surface of each half is the unpainted surface whose area is required. Reasoning: Place the circular face containing A and B in the z=0 plane, with center (0,0,0), cylinder center (0,0,4), cylinder radius 6, and height 8. Arc AB is 120°, so the distance from chord AB to the circle center is 6cos60°=3. Choose coordinates so that chord AB is located at x=3, z=0, then the y-coordinates of A and B are ±3√3. The cutting plane passes through the line x=3,z=0 and the point (0,0,4), so its equation is z=4-(4/3)x, namely x=3-(3/4)z. Parameterize this cutting surface using (y,z). The cylinder condition is x²+y²≤36, so y²≤36-(3-3z/4)², and 0≤z≤8. The area scaling factor is √(1+(dx/dz)²)=√(1+9/16)=5/4. Therefore the cutting surface area is (5/4)∫_0^8 2√(36-(3-3z/4)²) dz. Let x=3-3z/4, then dz=-(4/3)dx, and the integration interval changes from z=0 to 8 into x=3 to -3, so the area is (5/3)∫_{-3}^{3}2√(36-x²) dx. Compute the integral: ∫_{-3}^{3}2√(36-x²) dx = 12π+18√3. Therefore the area is (5/3)(12π+18√3)=20π+30√3. Thus a=20, b=30, c=3, so a+b+c=53.

method.method_draft: Coordinate/integration route. Read from the figure that the new unpainted face is the planar cross-section of the cylinder through chord AB on one circular face and the cylinder center. From the text, take radius 6, height 8, and arc AB = 120 degrees. Put the circular face containing A and B in the plane z=0 with center (0,0,0), cylinder center at (0,0,4), and choose coordinates so chord AB is the vertical chord x=3 because its distance from the circle center is 6 cos 60 = 3. Then A and B have y-values ±3√3. The cutting plane through x=3,z=0 and (0,0,4) has equation z=4-(4/3)x, or x=3-(3/4)z. Parametrize the face by (y,z); the cylinder condition gives y^2 <= 36 - (3-3z/4)^2 for 0 <= z <= 8, and the area scale factor is sqrt(1+(dx/dz)^2)=5/4. Evaluate area = (5/4)∫_0^8 2sqrt(36-(3-3z/4)^2) dz. Substitute x=3-3z/4 to get (5/3)∫_{-3}^3 2sqrt(36-x^2) dx = (5/3)(12π+18√3)=20π+30√3. Thus a=20,b=30,c=3, so a+b+c=53.

method.method_draft: Projection and circular-segment route. Read from the figure that the unpainted face is a slanted flat cut; its orthogonal projection onto a circular base is a band between two parallel chords. From the text, radius is 6, height is 8, and chord AB subtends 120 degrees. Since chord AB is distance 6 cos 60 = 3 from the base center, in the vertical cross-section perpendicular to AB the cutting line goes from the bottom chord point, 3 units to one side of the axis, through the cylinder center 4 units above the base, and reaches the top face 3 units to the opposite side. This gives a 3-4-5 triangle, so areas in the slanted plane are larger than their horizontal projections by factor 5/3. The projected band in the circular face is the part of the radius-6 disk between the two parallel chords at distance 3 from the center. Each excluded circular cap has sector angle 120 degrees, so cap area = (120/360)·36π - (1/2)·6·6·sin120 = 12π - 9√3. Therefore projected band area = 36π - 2(12π - 9√3)=12π+18√3. Multiply by 5/3 to get the unpainted face area 20π+30√3, giving a+b+c=20+30+3=53.

图像显示圆柱被一个斜切平面切成两半，切面穿过同一圆形底面边缘上的点 A、B，并延伸到圆柱另一侧，形成一个平坦的未涂色斜面。图中可见 A、B 在圆周上，切面相对于底面是倾斜的。

按投影与圆段方法计算：切面的正交投影到圆形底面上，是半径为 6 的圆盘中夹在两条平行弦之间的带状区域。因为弧 AB 为 120°，所以弦 AB 到圆心的距离为 6cos60°=3。

在垂直于 AB 的截面中，切割线从底面上一条距轴 3 的弦经过圆柱中心，高度为 4，再到顶面上距轴另一侧 3 的弦。因此水平偏移为 3，高度偏移为 4，形成 3-4-5 三角形，所以斜切面面积等于其水平投影面积乘以 5/3。

圆盘面积为 36π。每个被排除的圆帽对应 120° 扇形减去等腰三角形：圆帽面积 = (120/360)·36π - (1/2)·6·6·sin120° = 12π - 9√3。

所以投影带状区域面积为 36π - 2(12π - 9√3) = 12π + 18√3。

斜切面面积为 (5/3)(12π + 18√3)=20π+30√3。因此 a=20, b=30, c=3，a+b+c=53。
